+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def extract_key_values(document_text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    prompt = (
+        "Extract key-value pairs from the following form-like document. "
+        "Return only valid JSON as an object mapping keys to values.\n\n"
+        f"Document:\n{document_text}"
+    )
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={
+            "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+            "input": prompt,
+        },
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+
+    text = ""
+    if isinstance(payload, dict):
+        output = payload.get("output", [])
+        for item in output:
+            content = item.get("content", []) if isinstance(item, dict) else []
+            for block in content:
+                if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                    text += block.get("text", "")
+
+    text = text.strip()
+    if not text:
+        raise RuntimeError("No extraction text returned from OpenAI")
+
+    return json.loads(text)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    document_text = sys.stdin.read()
+    result = extract_key_values(document_text)
+    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    sys.stdout.write("\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import os
+import json
+import base64
+import sys
+from urllib import request, error
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _read_input_bytes(path_or_dash: str) -> bytes:
+    if path_or_dash == "-":
+        return sys.stdin.buffer.read()
+    with open(path_or_dash, "rb") as f:
+        return f.read()
+
+
+def _encode_document(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")
+
+
+def extract_tables(document_path: str) -> dict:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    document_bytes = _read_input_bytes(document_path)
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {
+                        "type": "input_text",
+                        "text": "Extract all tables from the attached document. Return JSON with tables, each table containing row order and cell text. Preserve row and cell structure as accurately as possible.",
+                    },
+                    {
+                        "type": "input_file",
+                        "filename": os.path.basename(document_path) if document_path != "-" else "document",
+                        "file_data": _encode_document(document_bytes),
+                    },
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "text": {"format": {"type": "json_object"}},
+    }
+
+    req = request.Request(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        method="POST",
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
+            response_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    except error.HTTPError as e:
+        raise RuntimeError(e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")) from e
+
+    output_text = []
+    for item in response_data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"} and content.get("text"):
+                output_text.append(content["text"])
+
+    if output_text:
+        return json.loads("".join(output_text))
+    return response_data
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: extract_tables.py <document-path-or->")
+    result = extract_tables(sys.argv[1])
+    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
*** End Patch
